name: minio-cold
description: MinIO (S3-compatible object storage, single-node/SNSD) - COLD variant with guaranteed consistency: stops the MinIO container via a pre-hook, then takes the restic snapshot with the data directory at rest (true crash consistency, no torn xl.meta) and restarts the container via a post-hook. The post-hook ALWAYS runs - even if the backup fails - so MinIO reliably comes back. Price: brief downtime during the snapshot. Use this variant for actively written instances; for lightly used ones 'minio' is enough (no hooks, no downtime). Hooks run as root and only after explicit approval ('--allow-hooks'). Assumption: the Compose service is named 'minio' and the volume lives under 'minio-data' (adjust the commands and exclude prefix if needed). RESTORE: requires the same MINIO_ROOT_USER/MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD and - if set - the same MINIO_KMS_SECRET_KEY (lives in the compose env, NOT in minio-data).

pre_backup.name: stop MinIO for a consistent cold snapshot

post_backup.cmd: docker compose -f "$DOCKER_BACKUP_COMPOSE_FILE" start minio || docker compose -f "$DOCKER_BACKUP_COMPOSE_FILE" up -d minio
post_backup.name: restart MinIO after the snapshot
